# HoopaDex

> A generation-aware Pokédex in one HTML file. It shows types, stats, abilities, moves and evolutions as they were in the game you pick: Generations I–IX game by game, Pokémon Champions regulation by regulation, and six ROM hacks (Renegade Platinum, Sacred Gold / Storm Silver, Platinum Kaizo, Emerald Kaizo, FireRed Omega, Run & Bun).

Every derived table is generated by a script from a named source (PokéAPI, Pokémon Showdown, the ROM hack authors' documentation) and checked against a second source. If pokeapi.co is unavailable, the app falls back to a weekly-synced archive of PokéAPI's raw data.

## App

- [HoopaDex (live)](https://willhoop.github.io/hoopadex/app/): the application
- [Source](https://github.com/willhoop/hoopadex): repository

## Documentation

- [White paper](https://github.com/willhoop/hoopadex/blob/main/docs/HOOPADEX-whitepaper.md): results, figures and sources
- [Plain-English deck](https://github.com/willhoop/hoopadex/blob/main/docs/HOOPADEX-deck-plain-english.md): the same story for a general reader
- [Technical documentation](https://github.com/willhoop/hoopadex/blob/main/docs/HOOPADEX-technical-docs.md): install, run and maintain
- [Changelog](https://github.com/willhoop/hoopadex/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): every change, with the reason

## Data

- [Champions learnsets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/willhoop/hoopadex/main/app/champions-learnsets.json): move legality per Pokémon Champions regulation
- [PokéAPI archive](https://github.com/willhoop/pokeapi-data): fork of PokeAPI/api-data, synced weekly, add and update only
